meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 十项「好设计」原则逐条审查你的设计，每项打 0–3 分并附证据，判定新做、改进还是重做，最后给出可直接运行的 /make-plan 提示词。
howto.when: 当你说「audit this design」「design review」「这个 UI 好不好」等，或想要一份能落到计划的批评时触发。

say.text: 审查一下这个页面，按 Rams 十项原则打分
say.note: 逐项打分附证据，产出审查文件

say.text: 看看这个 UI 够不够好，需要重做还是改进
say.note: 给出 NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN 判定与理由

say.text: 这个设计还没做出来，直接进入计划阶段
say.note: 跳过取证，直接出新设计的计划提示词

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, picks a NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN verdict, and hands off a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "audit this design", "design review", "is this UI good", etc., or ask for a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this page against Rams' ten principles
say_en.note: Scores each principle with cited evidence in audit files.

say_en.text: Is this UI good — refine it or redesign it?
say_en.note: Returns a NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN verdict with reasons.

say_en.text: The design doesn't exist yet — go straight to the plan
say_en.note: Skips evidence gathering, emits a NEW design /make-plan prompt.
